title: Manual intervention
description: Pause the task and wait for a human to approve or reject. The whole task pauses before this step's wave runs — no target is touched until somebody decides.

Octopus.Action.Manual.Instructions.label: Instructions (markdown)
Octopus.Action.Manual.Instructions.helpText: Shown to the approver. Octostache #{...} placeholders are resolved when the task pauses, so the approver reads real values rather than the template.

Octopus.Action.Manual.ResponsibleTeamIds.label: Responsible teams
Octopus.Action.Manual.ResponsibleTeamIds.helpText: Leave EMPTY to let anyone in this Space holding the approve permission respond. Selections are stored as team ids, so a process imported from Octopus carries Octopus ids that resolve to nothing: the import reports them as a warning, saving the step here is refused until they are re-pointed at real teams, and a deployment that reaches the gate anyway FAILS rather than proceeding — because ignoring an unresolvable list would widen the approver set to everyone instead of narrowing it.

Kraken.Action.Manual.TimeoutHours.label: Auto-fail after (hours)
Kraken.Action.Manual.TimeoutHours.helpText: Blank uses the server default (72 h). 0 waits indefinitely. On expiry the task fails exactly as if rejected, and its Failure/Always cleanup steps still run.

Octopus.Action.Manual.BlockConcurrentDep.label: Block concurrent deployments
Octopus.Action.Manual.BlockConcurrentDep.helpText: Informational only. Kraken already serializes deployments per project + environment + tenant unconditionally, which is stronger — and a paused task keeps holding that slot until it is answered or times out.
